explanation: This unit is about 0 at every GO and D2 step, and at D1 it depends only on whether the previous trial ended in S2 (reward does not matter): if it ended in S1 the value is 0. If it ended in S2, the value is 10 when that S2 came from a rare transition after choosing a1, or was the first S2 after S1 visits, and about 6-8 (usually 7) during a steady run of choosing a2 and reaching S2.
